subject.title: fix(android): stream replies into view and shrink "Jump to latest" to a compact icon button

question: Should Android follow the live edge for every new user turn, or retain its prompt-anchored layout outside a demonstrated constrained-viewport case such as an open IME?
rationale: The patch deliberately replaces a default reader behavior across all Android turns; the related iOS implementation chose a keyboard-scoped policy, so the appropriate Android product boundary needs an explicit owner decision.

options.title: Preserve non-IME anchoring
options.body: Limit live-edge following to the Android condition that demonstrably needs it, while preserving the existing prompt-anchor behavior elsewhere and adding regression coverage.

options.title: Adopt all-turn live following
options.body: Accept the Android-wide reading-layout change and document it as intentional with proof for both IME-open and IME-closed chat flows.

recommendation.title: Preserve non-IME anchoring
recommendation.body: Limit live-edge following to the Android condition that demonstrably needs it, while preserving the existing prompt-anchor behavior elsewhere and adding regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged iOS reader work is the closest available precedent for defining the intended cross-platform policy.
